text:
PagerDuty: PAGERDUTY ALERT - multiple failed auth attempts + surge in token refreshes for service account 'svc-inference-prod' in us-west-2. Spike started ~2026-03-10T03:42Z. ~200+ refreshes/min. Possible leaked key. Severity: P1. Paging on-call.

AJ (oncall): acked. I'm on. pulling logs now. Sam, Maya, can you take?

Sam K: on it. checking access logs and secrets manager.

Maya R: I see a burst of requests from 54.243.12.77 and 54.184.22.6 hitting /auth/refresh and /s3/proxy GETs to logs-prod-raw. lots of short-lived sessions + repeated refresh failures.

Derek: which bucket paths? could be presigned URL abuse?

Maya R: patterns: GET /objects/logs/2026/03/* and a few /objects/app-logs/* with referrer: internal-dashboard. Looks like automated hits using a service credential.

SecOpsBot: Incident INC-2026-045 created. Triage leads: AJ (oncall), Sam K, Maya R.

AJ (oncall): containment checklist: 1) rotate svc-inference-prod credentials 2) block offending IPs at WAF/edge 3) revoke active refresh tokens for that service 4) snapshot logs for forensic 5) notify legal/cs if customer exposure suspected.

Sam K: starting key rotation now. plan: create new access key, push to Secrets Manager, deploy, then deactivate/delete old key.

Sam K: commands I'm running:
```
# create new key and save locally
aws iam create-access-key --user-name svc-inference-prod > /tmp/new_key.json
# update secrets manager with new key material
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id prod/svc-inference-prod/key --secret-string file:///tmp/new_key.json
# deactivate old key then delete after propagation
aws iam update-access-key --user-name svc-inference-prod --access-key-id OLDKEY --status Inactive
aws iam delete-access-key --user-name svc-inference-prod --access-key-id OLDKEY
```

Maya R: I'm triggering internal revoke endpoint to blow away refresh tokens for that service: POST /internal/auth/revoke?service=svc-inference-prod (rerun across regions).

AJ (oncall): pushed WAF block rules for 54.243.12.77/32 and 54.184.22.6/32 at edge. traffic dropped ~90% to auth endpoint.

Liz C: CS check-in: any customer-facing impact yet? need to prepare template if we must notify. which accounts saw activity?

Maya R: quick look shows background jobs for corp-customer-47 using that service key; their jobs failed on rotation and retried. so internal jobs impacted, not end-user logins. no user accounts observed.

Derek: I cross-checked S3 access patterns for PII markers — no matches in timeframe. copying forensic snapshot: s3://sec-forensics/INC-2026-045/1765008100/

Legal: preserve all logs and snapshots. loop us before any customer communication. we'll advise on wording.

IncidentBot: action items logged -> [rotate_keys, block_ips, revoke_sessions, forensic_snapshot, cs_notify_check].

Maya R: running requeue for failed jobs and adding backoff to avoid immediate retries.

Sam K: new key created and pushed to Secrets Manager at 03:48Z, rotation deployed to services at ~03:50Z. old key deactivated and deleted after propagation.

AJ (oncall): monitoring metrics: auth failures dropped to baseline, no new suspicious IPs after WAF block. will keep watch for 30m.

Derek: I'll take second-shift handoff in 20m. notes for handoff: rotated keys, WAF blocks in place, revocations executed, forensic snapshot saved, CS draft ready pending legal.

Liz C: drafting customer template: "We detected suspicious activity involving a service account used for background processing. We rotated credentials and took containment steps. We have no evidence of customer data exposure at this time; investigation ongoing." Holding until Legal sign-off.

Legal: reviewed template, language ok. remove any speculative words if we escalate. approve to send once we confirm no PII.

AJ (oncall): quick TL;DR for handoff -> initial spike 03:42Z, suspected leaked service key, rotated keys 03:48-03:50Z, WAF blocks 03:50Z, revoked refresh tokens 03:52Z, forensic snapshot 03:55Z. status: mitigated, monitoring.

IncidentBot: incident status updated -> MITIGATED (pending postmortem).

Sam K: post-incident tasks: enforce hourly rotation for prod service keys (short-term), add alert for >50 token refreshes/min per service account, tighten presigned URL usage logs + anomaly detection.

Derek: assigning PM for postmortem + eng-security to run RCA and follow-ups.

AJ (oncall): handing off to @Derek. please ping if anything pops. great job team. :v:
